items.title: 声で岩を呼び，足場を動かす「ミナと言霊の物語」。言葉を操作に変える3Dアクションを試遊し，開発者に話を聞いた［OIGS2026］
items.summary: 「ロック」と唱えると岩が現れ，「エレベ」と唱えると足場が動く。OIGS2026で試遊した「ミナと言霊の物語」は，コントローラでの移動と，声で物を呼び出す操作を組み合わせた3Dアクションゲームだ。声を使う遊びの面白さを紹介し，音声認識エンジンを自作した開発者のyoshi氏へのインタビューをお届けする。

zh.title: 《米娜与神灵的故事》中，一个声音呼唤着一块岩石，移动了脚手架。我们尝试了一款将文字转化为操作的 3D 动作游戏，并与开发者进行了交谈 [OIGS2026]
zh.summary: 当你说“岩石”时，就会出现一块岩石，当你说“升高”时，脚手架就会移动。我在 OIGS2026 上尝试过的《米娜与精​​灵的故事》是一款 3D 动作游戏，结合了控制器的运动和通过语音调用事物的操作。为了介绍玩声音的乐趣，我们对 Yoshi 先生进行了采访，他创建了自己的语音识别引擎。

en.title: ``The story of Mina and the spirits'' in which a voice calls a rock and moves the scaffolding. We tried out a 3D action game that turns words into operations and spoke to the developer [OIGS2026]
en.summary: When you say "Rock" a rock appears, and when you say "Elevate" the scaffolding moves. ``The Story of Mina and the Spirits,'' which I tried out at OIGS2026, is a 3D action game that combines movement with a controller and operations that call things by voice. Introducing the fun of playing with your voice, we present an interview with Mr. Yoshi, the developer who created his own voice recognition engine.

items.title: 自分好みの美少女プラモで対戦。3Dアクション「カスタムメカ娘ファイターズ」の開発者に，カスタマイズとバトルの楽しさを聞いた［OIGS2026］
items.summary: 好きなボディや武器を組み合わせたメカ娘で，1対1のバトルを繰り広げる「カスタムメカ娘ファイターズ」。OIGS2026で試遊したところ，機体のカスタマイズが楽しそうだと感じた。ディレクターのカーバンクル氏とプログラマーの山田裕貴氏に，企画の出発点やカスタマイズを支える仕組み，今後の展開について聞いた。

zh.title: 与你最喜欢的塑料模特女孩竞争。我们向3D动作游戏《定制机甲少女战士》的开发商询问了定制和战斗的乐趣[OIGS2026]
zh.summary: 《定制机甲少女战士》是机甲少女们结合自己喜爱的身体和武器进行的一对一战斗。当我在OIGS2026上尝试时，我觉得定制飞机似乎很有趣。我们向总监 Carbuncle 和程序员 Yuki Yamada 询问了项目的出发点、支持定制的机制以及未来的发展。

en.title: Compete with your favorite plastic model girl. We asked the developer of the 3D action game "Custom Mecha Girl Fighters" about the fun of customization and battle [OIGS2026]
en.summary: "Custom Mecha Girl Fighters" is a one-on-one battle between mecha girls who combine their favorite bodies and weapons. When I tried it at OIGS2026, I felt that customizing the aircraft seemed fun. We asked director Carbuncle and programmer Yuki Yamada about the starting point of the project, the mechanisms that support customization, and future developments.

items.title: クナイを足場に，時間を止めて道を開く。2D探索型アクション「常夜渡りの忍」の手触りのよさはどう生まれるのか［OIGS2026］
items.summary: OIGS2026で，2D探索型アクション「常夜渡りの忍」を試遊した。壁に刺したクナイに乗り，時間を止めて空中にも足場を作る。アクションゲームが苦手な筆者にも遊びやすく，ダッシュやジャンプが気持ちよい。手触りを磨く工夫や，クナイと時間停止を組み合わせた経緯を，開発者のキャス氏に聞いた。

zh.title: 以苦无为立足点，时间被停止，道路被开辟。 2D探索动作游戏《夜行忍者》的良好手感是如何打造的？ [OIGS2026]
zh.summary: 在OIGS2026上，我尝试了2D探索动作游戏《夜行者忍》。骑在墙上的苦无上，他可以停止时间并在空中建立立足点。即使对于不喜欢动作游戏的我来说也很容易玩，冲刺和跳跃的感觉也很好。我们向开发者 Cass 询问了他如何改进纹理以及如何将苦无和时间停止结合起来。

en.title: Using kunai as footholds, time is stopped and a path is opened. How is the good feel of the 2D exploratory action game “Night-Wandering Shinobi” created? [OIGS2026]
en.summary: At OIGS2026, I tried out the 2D exploration action game ``Nightwalker Shinobi''. Riding on a kunai stuck in the wall, he can stop time and create a foothold in the air. It's easy to play even for me, who doesn't like action games, and the dashes and jumps feel good. We asked the developer, Cass, about how he refined the texture and how he combined kunai and time stop.

items.title: 秋促仅需8.4的《火线迈阿密》，凭什么让人死到红温还舍不得关游戏？
items.summary: 如果预算只有10元，去推荐一款高难度又极度耐玩的游戏，你最想推荐谁？首先排除《和班尼福特一起掘地求生》，它确实很难，但绝大数人红温之后都会选择离开。其次《Limbo》、《Inside》、《Braid》这样的，解谜难度高不假，也能讲好一个故事，只是通关后便再少捡起来的机会。 如果只允许推荐一款，那我一定会推荐2012年的老古董《火线迈阿密》（Hotline Miami）。作为非常古老的俯视角射击游戏，它的胜利条件严苛到惊人的程度：你一次只有1条命，然后击败所有的敌人。 该系列的玩家已经超过500万，在不支持中文的情况下，仍有不少国区玩家“痛并快乐着”，称其为火线迈R密（因为重置关卡需要按R键）。

ja.title: 秋のプロモーションに必要なのは「FireWire Miami」の 8.4 だけです。なぜ人は死んでもゲームを閉じることをためらうのでしょうか?
ja.summary: 予算が 10 元しかなくて、難しくて非常にプレイしやすいゲームをお勧めするように求められたら、誰を一番お勧めしますか?まず、「Dig to Survive with Benny Ford」を除外します。それは確かに難しいことですが、大多数の人は赤熱を感じたら辞めることを選択するでしょう。次に、「Limbo」、「Inside」、「Braid」などのゲームはパズルを解くのが難しく、優れたストーリーを伝えることができますが、レベルを完了した後に手に入れる機会が少なくなります。 1 つだけお勧めできるとしたら、2012 年の名作『ホットライン マイアミ』を間違いなくお勧めします。非常に古いトップダウン シューティング ゲームであるため、その勝利条件は驚くほど厳しく、一度にライフを 1 つだけ持ち、その後すべての敵を倒します。このシリーズには 500 万人以上のプレイヤーがいます。中国語には対応していませんが、国内では「痛快」で FireWire Mai R の秘伝と呼んでいるプレイヤーが今でもたくさんいます (レベルをリセットするには R キーを押す必要があるため)。

en.title: The Autumn Promotion only requires 8.4 of "FireWire Miami", why is it that people are reluctant to close the game even after death?
en.summary: If you had a budget of only 10 yuan and were asked to recommend a difficult and extremely playable game, who would you most recommend? First of all, exclude "Dig to Survive with Benny Ford". It is indeed difficult, but the vast majority of people will choose to leave after red temperature. Secondly, games like "Limbo", "Inside", and "Braid" are difficult to solve puzzles and can tell a good story, but there are fewer opportunities to pick them up after completing the level. If I could only recommend one, I would definitely recommend the 2012 classic "Hotline Miami". As a very old top-down shooting game, its victory conditions are surprisingly strict: you only have one life at a time, and then defeat all enemies. There are more than 5 million players in this series. Even though it does not support Chinese, there are still many players in the country who are "painful and happy" and call it FireWire Mai R secret (because you need to press the R key to reset the level).

Generally speaking, they were very relaxed and comfortable. Behind me was a cosplayer who cosplayed as an Inugami. At first he was taking photos with other people, but then he seemed a little tired. He sat down cross-legged, took off his hood and held it in his arms. His face was very red and there was sweat on his forehead. The weather in Guangzhou these days is indeed very hot. In a sense, this "heat" also connects my usual feelings about "Onmyoji": intimacy, warmth, and longevity. Players waiting for the show to start gathered under the stage. Suddenly, there was some small commotion among the players on the side of the stage: a girl seemed to be standing up to hand out homemade materials, and the entire scene immediately became lively.

The real-time strategy type "StarCraft 2" was launched in 2003 and was not released until 2010. DLC updates will be stopped in 2020. en.title: Research shows that elderly people raised in socialist East Germany have better cognitive function than those raised in West Germany.
en.summary: After World War II, Germany was divided into the German Democratic Republic (East Germany) and the Federal Republic of Germany (West Germany), and was reunified in 1990 with East Germany being incorporated into West Germany. en.title: Why does GPU smuggling to China continue and why is the US government unable to crack down on it?
en.summary: While the United States has restricted the export of cutting-edge AI semiconductors to China, there have been a number of incidents of illegal shipments to China through companies and logistics networks in third countries.
